attributes.board_name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions – State Board for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Formal CE courses/workshops and self-study from NYSED-approved sponsors (AAA, ASHA, IACET, NYSSLHA or Department-approved); formal academic study (1 semester hour = 15 hours, 1 quarter hour = 10); teacher in-service in a school/BOCES professional development plan; mentoring; study groups (1 hour per 2 contact hours); independent study (1 hour per 3 clock hours, max 1/6 of total); other learning activities acceptable to the Department. 1 hour = at least 50 minutes; 1 CEU = 10 contact hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the triennial registration period in which first licensed in New York (applies to new graduates; a licensee newly licensed in NY who practiced elsewhere must meet the requirement).
rules.audit_note: Set written learning goals at the start of each registration cycle and keep a learning-activity log and records for 6 years; the Department may audit. A licensee short of hours may obtain a conditional registration.
rules.notes: Audiologists who dispense hearing aids: 6 of the professional hours (2 per year) must be in hearing aid selection and/or fitting from an approved sponsor (no topic code yet). 30 hours per triennial registration, at least 20 in the professional area (normal processes and assessment/treatment of speech, voice, language, hearing and swallowing disorders); the rest may be in related areas (legal/regulatory, reimbursement, supervision, business practices, pedagogy, ethics). At most two-thirds may be self-directed online/self-study; at least one-third must be in-person, live online or synchronous study or other learning activities. Dually licensed SLP + audiologist: 20 professional hours in each discipline + 10 related hours. Licensees not practicing may file an exemption statement. NY does not license SLP assistants.
